# June 2023 legacy status cleanup

Historical snapshot as of June 3, 2023. This note records project status only; it is not a current plan, approval, launch signal, or decision record.

## Expansion-nudge experiment

- `EXP-2023-05-expansion-nudge` was live, with a still-tiny sample.
- It targeted retained mid-segment v2 accounts (75–200 seats) through the in-product, PostHog-flagged `expansion_nudge_60d_v1` prompt.
- The early read was not sufficient for interpretation or rollout decisions.

## Small-business-tier initiative

- Discovery was moving into substantive June work.
- The initiative was being treated as an internal self-serve operating-model effort, not a public pricing-page launch or Q3 promise.

## Mid-segment churn documentation and related all-hands work

- The churn investigation document and related all-hands work were complete (“done done now”).
- The work covered the investigation method and reusable documentation framework; it was not an active investigation or launch project.

All statuses above are historical and should not be inferred as current activity, completion, approval, or decision readiness.
